name: Bikky
oneLiner: Customer data platform built for multi-unit restaurant brands: it unifies POS, online ordering, payment and loyalty data into de-duplicated guest profiles and adds guest analytics, campaign measurement and an AI analyst (Data Assistant).
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant brands (regional chains to several hundred locations) that want one clean view of guest behavior across channels and a way to measure marketing and menu decisions.

updates.text: Condado Tacos launched a burrito limited-time offer based on guest insights from Bikky.

Mellow Mushroom announced it uses Bikky for data-driven marketing and expansion; the release describes Data Assistant as Bikky's recently launched AI analyst that answers questions about guest data in seconds.
Bubbakoo's Burritos chose Bikky to power personalization and its data strategy.

features: Prebuilt integrations with POS, online ordering, payment and loyalty systems
Cleaned, standardized and de-duplicated guest profiles across all locations and channels
Guest frequency, retention and lifetime value analytics
Menu and channel performance tied to guest behavior (useful for testing LTOs)
Data Assistant: ask questions of your guest data in plain language
Data sharing to a warehouse or files (Snowflake, SFTP, CSV)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Bikky does not publish prices.

notes: bikky.com could not be fetched; facts come from search results of Bikky press releases and trade press. Other brands named as customers in press coverage: Bojangles (800 locations, March 2024), Dave's Hot Chicken, Long John Silver's, Robeks, MOD Pizza (April 2024), Playa Bowls, Haven Hot Chicken (Dec 2024), Postino. Snowflake/SFTP/CSV sharing is carried over from the current review and was not re-verified this session. The Tiki Taco source is an AOL syndication of the June 17, 2025 GlobeNewswire release. Funding: ~$8M Series A (Dec 2023) per third-party profiles. No 2026 product launch found.
